title: Unauthenticated telemetry can generate critical alerts
status: Code implemented; live activation pending
recommended_change: require a provisioned station identity, restrict it to its own station, and authenticate both HTTP and MQTT ingestion. Reserve staff credentials for administration. Add payload/rate budgets and independently protect the broker. CORS does not authenticate devices. OWASP's API controls support explicit authorization and resource limits. [OWASP API risks](https://api-security.owasp.org/editions/2023/en/0x00-header/), [resource consumption](https://api-security.owasp.org/editions/2023/en/0xa4-unrestricted-resource-consumption/)
acceptance_criteria: anonymous/expired/revoked credentials and a credential for another station cannot write samples or create alert/outbox rows. Valid station traffic still works through both transports.

title: Station provisioning is open to anonymous callers
status: Code implemented; live activation pending
recommended_change: admin-only provisioning with commissioning state, verified coordinates/datum, device binding and an audit record. Decide explicitly whether read-only station/telemetry data is public; current GETs are also anonymous, which may be intentional and should be documented.
acceptance_criteria: anonymous and resident writes return an authorization error; admin provisioning records actor, reason, calibration and activation state.

title: An older unused sequence can overwrite current alert meaning
status: Code implemented; live activation pending
recommended_change: retain late samples as historical records where appropriate, but update current state only under an atomic ordering rule. Introduce device boot/session identity and measured-time semantics; do not assume arrival order equals measurement order. Preserve exact duplicate/conflicting-payload distinctions.
acceptance_criteria: delayed, duplicated, rebooted and reordered messages cannot roll current measurements or episodes backward. Test concurrent HTTP/MQTT arrival as well as ordinary sequential requests.

title: Retained MQTT water samples can appear freshly measured
status: Code implemented; live activation pending
recommended_change: reject retained operational water telemetry or ingest it strictly as historical/untrusted-for-current-state. Define an envelope with measured time, device uptime, boot ID, schema/config version and source identity.
acceptance_criteria: a retained sample cannot advance `last_ping`, restore LIVE status or transition an alert. Include first-subscription and reconnect tests.

title: Physical-device provenance is inferred from a client-controlled string
status: Code implemented; live activation pending
recommended_change: persist trusted ingress identity and an explicit source class assigned by the authenticated gateway/device registry. Store firmware version separately. Separate exercise and operational streams or namespaces.
acceptance_criteria: HTTP simulators and arbitrary publishers cannot claim physical provenance by changing a firmware string. Hybrid sensor initialization accepts only a trusted physical source.

title: Heartbeat age and last-valid measurement age are conflated
status: Code implemented; live activation pending
recommended_change: expose heartbeat time, latest-sample time, last-valid-depth time, quality and per-channel freshness separately. Query the last valid observation independently of chart window length. Define whether an active historical hazard is unresolved versus currently observed.
acceptance_criteria: invalid heartbeats keep device connectivity separate from measurement freshness; web, mobile, maps, reports and model initialization show the same true age of the retained measurement.

title: Missing measurements are converted to numerical zero in the web model
status: Code implemented; client rollout pending
recommended_change: use nullable measurement objects throughout; display an em dash and explicit reason. Exclude unavailable samples from extrema and aggregate statistics, with a coverage count. Retained historical values need their own timestamp and quality state.
acceptance_criteria: no data, valid zero, stale nonzero and invalid data produce four distinct presentations and correct aggregates on every screen and export.

title: Resident home falls back to simulated warning values
status: Code implemented; client rollout pending
recommended_change: give operational home a true unknown state with last-known data where available. Move simulation into a deliberately entered exercise workspace with persistent labeling; never auto-enter it because a feed failed. Replace the hardcoded San Vicente home heading with the actual profile/selected-station context.
acceptance_criteria: a new account, empty station, login delay and failed API never invent a hazard, depth, rainfall or rate. Exercise mode is explicit and cannot mutate operational state.

title: Single-sample thresholds produce noisy episodes
status: Code implemented; provisional policy and live activation pending
recommended_change: agree on station-specific hysteresis, recovery persistence, plausibility checks and an audited manual review/escalation policy with domain operators. Preserve immediate critical escalation when required; a generic delay for every severity would introduce a different risk. Threshold values and persistence rules need physical validation.
acceptance_criteria: realistic sensor noise does not chatter; sustained recovery resolves correctly; a genuine rapid rise is not suppressed; invalid readings never imply recovery.

title: Sensor tiers are sometimes phrased as official evacuation authority
status: Code implemented; provisional policy and live activation pending
recommended_change: define separate observation tier, forecast risk, official advisory and authority-issued action message. Use consistent copy and display issuing authority, area, effective time and expiry for official notices. CAP provides a useful exchange model for status, urgency, severity, certainty, updates and cancellations. [OASIS CAP 1.2](https://docs.oasis-open.org/emergency/cap/v1.2/CAP-v1.2-os.pdf)
acceptance_criteria: sensor and experimental states cannot appear as an official order. All official notices identify their issuer and lifecycle, including correction/cancellation.

title: Notifications are broadcast to every eligible resident device
status: Code implemented; provisional policy and live activation pending
recommended_change: introduce explicit station/area subscriptions, verified geographic identifiers and a citywide override with authority and reason. Model staff jurisdiction separately from public alert visibility. Do not infer flood exposure solely from nearest-station distance or a free-text barangay.
acceptance_criteria: ordinary station escalation reaches only intended subscriptions/areas; citywide actions are explicit and audited; changing a local UI label cannot silently change operational targeting.

title: System Health reports rain health using water-station connectivity
status: Code implemented; coordinated rollout and physical validation pending
recommended_change: a channel health contract should independently report water sensor, rain counter, device heartbeat, broker ingestion and calibration state. Preserve administrative state as another dimension.
acceptance_criteria: disconnecting only the rain feed changes rain health; a maintenance station is not counted as an unexpected outage; zero rain remains distinguishable from unknown rain.

title: Rise classifications ignore elapsed measurement time
status: Code implemented; provisional rate thresholds and physical validation pending
recommended_change: calculate a robust rate in cm/minute over a bounded valid-time window, with uncertainty and minimum coverage; label trend unknown when timing/coverage is insufficient. Do not substitute the example rates in mobile `AlertLevel`.
acceptance_criteria: equivalent physical rates at different sampling frequencies produce consistent trends; gaps and invalid observations do not manufacture stability.

title: Analytics aligns stations by row position and bridges gaps
status: Code implemented; coordinated rollout and physical validation pending
recommended_change: build a timestamp-keyed series with explicit aggregation/resampling policy and gaps. Add a bounded backend history/report query with timezone, coverage, event ID and station filters. Export exactly the selected scope with units, quality and source metadata.
acceptance_criteria: two stations sampled at different times cannot be falsely aligned; outages remain gaps; exported maxima and event intervals match database records. A CSV report must not imply a 24-hour analysis when only minutes of samples were loaded.

title: Legacy rainfall values have no explicit interval contract
status: Code implemented; coordinated journal and firmware rollout pending
recommended_change: version the telemetry envelope and record an explicit rainfall interval, quality, count and calibration version. Make the durable rain journal's defined products authoritative for rainfall panels; deprecate ambiguous quantities. Never fabricate hourly inputs by summing overlapping cumulative snapshots.
acceptance_criteria: all rainfall displays and features identify interval boundaries, source and missing coverage; firmware/API/client contract tests verify conservation, resets and outage recovery.

title: The default physical depth alarm cannot reach its critical threshold
status: Software guards and bench tests implemented; P0 physical geometry and operator acceptance pending
recommended_change: establish physically justified mounting/range/threshold geometry with a reliable margin through the entire warning range; do not simply lower a life-safety threshold to make the buzzer sound. Define and validate the blind-zone fault policy. Create a versioned commissioning/calibration record: datum, installation height, sensor range, uncertainty, thresholds, rain coefficient, reviewer and effective time. Devices report the applied config hash; local fail-safe rules remain available offline. Show disagreements rather than silently using different thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: the real acquisition path crosses every approved tier with measured range margin; blind-zone/invalid measurements follow the reviewed fault policy; differing device/server configurations are visible; each station displays its own coefficient; controlled volume and range tests are recorded before field claims. Cardboard bench output tests remain separately labeled.

title: Station lifecycle administration is incomplete and inconsistent
status: Code implemented; coordinated rollout and operator lifecycle review pending
recommended_change: explicitly model ingestion, observation visibility, local alarms and external notifications during maintenance; do not silently erase existing incidents. Add audited metadata/configuration updates and commissioning validation.
acceptance_criteria: each lifecycle state has documented behavior across water, rain, UI and notifications; configuration writes require authorization and conflict protection.

title: Profile switches do not consistently represent real capabilities
status: Code implemented; native OS and installed-device acceptance pending
recommended_change: persist actual product preferences; bind notifications to a documented preference and permission model; display OS permission, service availability and application choice separately. Label unavailable capabilities as unavailable instead of offering an inert control.
acceptance_criteria: preferences survive restart; turning a delivery preference off has the stated effect, subject to clearly defined official-critical-alert rules; displayed location permission matches the OS.

title: Language and geographic context are inconsistent
status: English-only policy implemented; geographic registry and client rollout pending
recommended_change: introduce real locale resources and reviewed hazard-message translations, stable geographic IDs, selected-area context, and build-generated version information. Ask community users which additional local language is useful rather than assuming one.
acceptance_criteria: changing language updates full critical flows; no partial untranslated emergency instruction remains; selected station and resident location are clearly distinct and correctly named.

title: Identity lifecycle and abuse protection need operational completion
status: Code implemented; SMTP, proxy, MFA and native deployment acceptance pending
recommended_change: implement verified recovery/invitation flows, staff MFA, session/device management, a shared abuse-control strategy and carefully trusted proxy identity. Hide unconfigured sign-in options. Require deliberate environment/bootstrap configuration at deployment rather than relying on development defaults.
acceptance_criteria: recovery tokens expire and are single-use; staff access is recoverable and auditable; limits behave consistently across workers and do not lock out an office behind a shared proxy by accident.

title: Administrative mutations lack a general audit and version contract
status: Code implemented; coordinated client rollout and audit database privileges pending
recommended_change: add explicit versions, atomic compare-and-update, reasons for privileged changes, and append-only audit events with redaction. Return 409 with refreshed values and require manual review; never automatically retry a stale mutation over newer data.
acceptance_criteria: two editors cannot silently overwrite each other; role/activation/threshold changes identify actor and reason; audit records never contain passwords or full push tokens.

title: SOS location updates have a concurrency race
status: Atomic SOS guards and SQLite races verified; PostgreSQL acceptance and client rollout pending
recommended_change: conditional update or row lock covering owner, expected version, lifecycle and capture time. Keep exact duplicate-fix idempotency and reject equal-time conflicts.
acceptance_criteria: real-engine concurrency tests show newer location survives, resolved requests stop accepting fixes, and losing writes return an explicit refresh-required conflict.

title: Practice SOS is not an operational response workflow
status: Configurable response drill implemented; operational mode disabled pending LGU procedures and witnessed drill
recommended_change: first agree on the actual LGU workflow, operators, hours and fallback contacts. Then implement assignment, contact attempts, accepted dispatch, arrival, closure reasons, timed escalation and resident-visible status. Keep exercises segregated. Introduce incident correlation without losing individual resident requests.
acceptance_criteria: a drill demonstrates ownership and escalation when the first officer is unavailable; every displayed response status has a real recorded action behind it. Operational mode is enabled only after those procedures are agreed and tested.

title: Shelter and route information is a demonstration-sized model
status: Authority registry and fallback implemented; verified live inventory and map/provider acceptance pending
recommended_change: an authority-maintained shelter registry with verification/expiry, capacity, services and access constraints; route warnings and blocked-road overlays; a usable text/list fallback when Maps fails. Avoid labeling a computed route safe without current evidence.
acceptance_criteria: inactive/full/unverified shelters are clearly distinguished; map quota, GPS denial and route failure leave usable verified instructions and contacts. Shelter updates show source and freshness.

title: Offline behavior is insufficient for a community response product
status: Encrypted reader cache and durable SOS outbox implemented; installed-device offline and storage acceptance pending
recommended_change: an encrypted local cache with original timestamps, stale labels and bounded retention; approved offline preparedness/contact content; a durable, user-visible SOS outbox using the existing exact-payload idempotency rules. Never label a queued request received or automatically overwrite a server-side conflict.
acceptance_criteria: airplane-mode cold launch, interrupted send, restart and reconnect preserve accurate received/queued/unknown distinctions. Users can inspect what remains unsent; no duplicate SOS or fabricated “live” reading appears.

title: Mobile maps use a second monitoring store with weaker freshness handling
status: Unified mobile observation/freshness view implemented; installed-device outage acceptance pending
recommended_change: use the shared monitoring controller and an immutable per-channel freshness view on both screens; guard request generations and invalidate expired markers without waiting for a successful network response.
acceptance_criteria: one disconnect, station switch, account switch and late response yield identical freshness/source/quality on home, map, detail and forecast.

title: Device transport is unsuitable for an exposed production network
status: Release TLS, scoped broker ACLs and nonce CSP implemented; intended-network deployment and secret-rotation acceptance pending
recommended_change: validated TLS, per-device broker ACLs, credential provisioning/rotation/revocation, a production HTTPS API origin, protected secret injection and separate environments. Broker configuration must be inspected in the actual deployment; its current external security was not assessed here. Add a restrictive web security-header/CSP policy compatible with Maps and the theme script, with rollout validation.
acceptance_criteria: wrong station, revoked credential, untrusted certificate and unauthorized topic operations fail; traffic confidentiality is verified on the intended deployment; development exceptions cannot enter release builds.

title: Water telemetry is latest-only and loses outage history
status: Bounded depth journal and historical ACK ingestion implemented; filesystem, endurance and device outage acceptance pending
recommended_change: specify the needed history and power budget, then add a bounded durable depth buffer or gateway journal with measured time, boot/sequence identity and application acknowledgments. Backfilled observations must not be treated as new hazards simply because they arrive later.
acceptance_criteria: a controlled outage/reboot retains the agreed history, reports gaps honestly, drains within resource limits, does not replay alerts, and leaves local fail-safe sensing responsive.

title: Schema evolution and production startup are not managed
status: Explicit versioned migrations and SQLite copy preservation verified; managed PostgreSQL restore/cutover acceptance pending
recommended_change: add ordered, reviewed, data-preserving migrations and a separate explicit demo bootstrap. Validate production settings at startup. Choose a managed PostgreSQL deployment when multi-user operation and recovery requirements justify it; adopt it through migration/restore testing, not a data reset.
acceptance_criteria: a copy of the current database upgrades without losing accounts, alert history, SOS or outbox state; migration/version mismatch blocks readiness; production startup never inserts demo records automatically.

title: Health checks do not report whether the service can perform its job
status: Implemented - isolated verification; deployment acceptance pending
recommended_change: separate liveness, readiness and dependency diagnostics. Add structured correlation IDs, ingestion/decision/delivery latency metrics, error budgets and an on-call runbook. Monitor the user-visible workflow rather than equating HTTP 200 with operational readiness.
acceptance_criteria: stop the worker, break broker authentication, remove an artifact, fill storage and interrupt a dependency in a test environment; each fault produces a specific operator alert and accurate user-facing degraded state.

title: Global rapid polling recomputes too much work per viewer
status: Implemented - bounded shared reads; device/network acceptance pending
recommended_change: a server-produced read model, bounded per-station queries, freshness-aware caching, coalesced subscriptions and SSE or another measured push approach where it helps. Retain a bounded reconnect/poll fallback. Compute shared inference once per input/config version, rather than once per viewer.
acceptance_criteria: measure CPU, query count, response bytes, battery/network use and p95/p99 end-to-end lag at agreed station/viewer counts; degrade gracefully when a client background/resumes. A push connection is not itself a guarantee of delivery or freshness.

title: Rain journal reads and raw event growth will become expensive
status: Implemented and locally verified; deployment retention/restore acceptance pending
recommended_change: initialize schema once, add query-plan-driven indexes and incremental hourly/lifetime summaries; archive raw data under a retention policy with integrity checks. Keep uncertain recovery and source/calibration boundaries explicit. Consider moving the journal to a managed store only after specifying its durability and transaction guarantees.
acceptance_criteria: long-history query benchmarks remain bounded at the agreed retention horizon; hourly totals and missingness reproduce the original journal; crash/restart and backup restore preserve ACK semantics.

title: Notification transport needs operator visibility and receipt evidence
status: Implemented and locally verified; controlled phone/deployment acceptance pending
recommended_change: supervise and monitor workers; add a reconciliation console with audited decisions, queue-age thresholds, expiry and delivery-stage evidence. Define fallback channels and consent/recipient rules. Keep `UNKNOWN` ambiguous until evidence resolves it; do not bulk reset it to pending.
acceptance_criteria: a controlled phone test distinguishes queued, provider accepted, app received, opened and user acknowledged where instrumented. Killing a worker at each send boundary does not cause an automatic duplicate or a silently stuck incident.

title: The operational water-depth predictor is not trained
status: Software pipeline and approval gates implemented; real field training/validation pending
recommended_change: decide the actual forecast target and datum for each site; collect quality-reviewed paired rainfall/water observations, calibration history and deployment-time data availability. Start with persistence and rate/trend baselines. Keep the current experimental path isolated until an independently evaluated operational adapter is approved.
acceptance_criteria: a model card identifies target, units, site, datum, data licenses, training cutoff, features actually available at inference, allowed use, error profile and fallback. A withheld set of real events demonstrates value over the agreed baseline.

title: Web and mobile can show different projections for the same station
status: Implemented; deployment and real-data activation acceptance pending
recommended_change: persist a reviewed station configuration/version and publish a single forecast product with forecast ID, data cutoff, model/config version, measurement source, generation time and expiry. Put private experiments in a visibly separate workspace. Have evaluation read the deployed registry rather than a separate filesystem constant. Add explicit Pydantic response schemas for hybrid outputs and generate or validate TypeScript/Dart contracts from OpenAPI.
acceptance_criteria: web and mobile opening the same forecast ID agree on all values and metadata; a private experiment cannot change residents' official view; an artifact switch updates evaluation and inference together. Production intentionally returns either an approved product or a clear unavailable state, not a development-only endpoint masquerading as available functionality.

title: Evaluation does not yet quantify field decision uncertainty
status: Software evaluation and runtime guards implemented; real-event uncertainty and domain approval pending
recommended_change: evaluate by horizon, storm/event, extreme intensity, season, site and missing-data regime; use blocked/event-based uncertainty estimates for serially correlated data. Establish candidate-versus-baseline release criteria, calibrated prediction intervals, out-of-distribution detection, drift monitoring and rollback. Align displayed precision with validated sensor/model uncertainty. NIST's AI RMF is a useful lifecycle framework, not a certification. [NIST AI RMF](https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework)
acceptance_criteria: agreed false-alarm/miss and lead-time tradeoffs are measured on withheld events; uncertainty coverage and fallback behavior are validated; no pooled mean score is presented as flood accuracy.

title: Local success does not reproduce the new feature set in clean CI/deployment
status: Implemented; local clean-source checks passed; hosted Linux/container/PostgreSQL execution pending
recommended_change: separate core, offline ML and hybrid integration jobs with explicit dependency sets; use small synthetic CI fixtures instead of requiring a developer's private training dataset. Package approved artifacts through an integrity-checked registry/build stage with licensing controls. Invoke web checks and meaningful browser workflows in CI. Add dependency/security scanning and validate from a fresh checkout.
acceptance_criteria: a clean CI runner and documented release build reproduce the selected feature profile without local ignored files, credentials or a developer virtual environment; web/backend/mobile contracts are checked together.

title: Android release signing is still configured for development
status: Release controls implemented and locally validated; protected signer, store artifact, iOS and physical-device acceptance pending
recommended_change: protected release signing, development/staging/production flavors, immutable version/build metadata, HTTPS configuration, restricted Maps keys, crash symbol handling and a release checklist. Validate Android and iOS separately; iOS release signing/APNs/device behavior was not established in this audit.
acceptance_criteria: a release artifact uses the intended protected signer and environment, excludes demo credentials/options, has measured startup/size/performance and passes physical-device permission, background, upgrade and notification tests.

title: Design needs an operational hierarchy and an accessibility test matrix
status: Shared semantics, responsive charts and accessibility fixes implemented; automated checks added; assistive-technology and participant validation pending
recommended_change: design shared semantic tokens for unknown/stale/invalid/exercise/official states; action-first page hierarchy; legible type; text alternatives and timestamped chart data; full keyboard/focus/reader behavior; large-text, reduced-motion and color-independent status. Use WCAG 2.2 AA as a web acceptance target, including its 24×24 CSS-pixel target-size rule and exceptions; adopt a larger practical target for stressed mobile use. [W3C WCAG 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/wcag/), [target sizing](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/target-size-minimum)
acceptance_criteria: verified contrast and focus in both themes, keyboard-only flows, TalkBack/VoiceOver checks, large text and narrow screens without loss of critical content. Representative residents/officers complete timed tasks with observed comprehension, including outage and uncertain-data scenarios.

title: Privacy, recovery and service ownership need deployment decisions
status: Implemented local controls - organizational approval and production recovery acceptance pending
recommended_change: inventory personal data and recipients, document purposes and access boundaries, minimize location retention and sharing, define data-subject workflows and incident response, encrypt backups and test restore. Agree on operator hours, accountable issuing authority, support, RPO/RTO and third-party cost/quota ownership. Have the responsible organization obtain appropriate privacy/legal review; this code audit is not a legal compliance determination.
acceptance_criteria: approved policies match actual behavior, a restore drill meets chosen recovery targets without replaying historical alerts, and access/retention exercises produce an auditable result.
